Evaluation of counterfactual inference accuracy (not detailed in provided chunks).

Evaluation of structural accuracy using AUC, F-score, SHD, and SID.

methods.name: PC algorithm
methods.protocol_description: Constraint-based algorithm that starts with a complete undirected graph, tests conditional independence for each edge with increasing conditioning set size, deletes edges when independence is found, and applies edge orientation rules to output a CPDAG.

methods.name: GES algorithm
methods.protocol_description: Score-based algorithm that searches over equivalence classes of DAGs using a greedy approach to optimize a score (e.g., BIC).

methods.name: GIES algorithm
methods.protocol_description: Extension of GES that incorporates interventional data to learn interventional Markov equivalence classes.

methods.name: FCI+ algorithm
methods.protocol_description: Constraint-based algorithm that allows latent variables and selection bias; extends FCI with additional orientation rules.

methods.name: MMHC algorithm
methods.protocol_description: Hybrid algorithm combining constraint-based (max-min parents and children) and score-based (hill-climbing) approaches.

methods.name: Active learning algorithm
methods.protocol_description: Active learning for Gaussian Bayesian networks that selects most informative interventions based on Bayesian inference over graph structures.

methods.name: GBN learned on observation data
methods.protocol_description: Gaussian Bayesian network structure learned from observational data.
